    How this works
    

      
Tidy works line by line: whitespace at both ends of a line is removed, every
        run of whitespace inside it becomes one ordinary space, and a run of blank lines shrinks to a
        single blank line, with none left at the start or the end. Keep indentation
        leaves the whitespace before a line's first visible character exactly as typed, tabs included,
        and tidies only what follows. One line turns every run of whitespace, line breaks
        included, into one space. No spaces deletes every space and tab but keeps the
        line breaks, which is what a phone number, an IBAN or a column of digits usually needs.
        No whitespace deletes the line breaks too. Drop blank lines
        removes every line that is empty or whitespace-only, in Tidy and No spaces.

      
Whitespace here is what the JavaScript \s class matches: space, tab, the line
        breaks, vertical tab, form feed, the no-break space U+00A0, the typographic spaces
        U+2000–U+200A, U+202F, U+205F,
        U+3000, U+1680, the line and paragraph separators
        U+2028/U+2029 and the byte order mark U+FEFF. Anything
        in that list other than a plain space, tab or line break is counted and named under the result,
        since those are what survive a find-and-replace of a typed space. Tidy writes them back as
        U+0020, so a no-break space between a number and its unit becomes a space a line
        can break at. The zero-width space U+200B, the joiners and the word joiner
        U+2060 are not whitespace by this definition and pass through untouched.
        \r\n and a lone \r count as line breaks; if the input held any
        \r\n, the lines are joined with \r\n again, otherwise with
        \n.

      
Input above 2,000,000 characters is refused rather than attempted, so the tab never
        hangs. Nothing is uploaded: there is no server in this file.

      
The Dark and language buttons remember their settings in this browser's local storage. Nothing you type or drop into the page is stored.
